task: continuous SAL plus L2-regularized POS logistic miss ranking
model: eta=a*z+b+sum(theta_c*word_overlap_fraction_c); a>=1e-6; rank eta without sigmoid saturation
objective: duration-weighted mean binary logloss plus lambda/2 * sum(theta^2); no class balancing
selection: 5 recording-grouped stratified folds within train only; pooled 5% recovery; exact ties prefer larger lambda
group_mapping: No reliable source-group map; recording is grouping unit
bootstrap: Fixed selected candidates, paired resampling of recordings; no model refitting
limitations: Dev has already been explored; not an untouched test.
Released SAL train predictions are in-sample, not out-of-fold detector predictions.
Only POS and word timing/confidence, not a model of full sentence meaning.
Candidate recall is not final correction performance.
